article.title: Perplexity公布Teammates持續任務代理，先向Max網頁用戶推出
article.title_en: Perplexity announces Teammates for ongoing work, initially on the web for Max users
article.summary: 11月4日官方文章描述代理可接續項目、分工並提交結果供審閱。
article.summary_en: The November 4 official post describes agents that carry projects forward, coordinate work and return results for review.
highlights: 可沿用Computer的項目、技能、記憶及已連接工具。
原文列明網頁先行、iOS稍後，並保留既有權限與審閱操作。
highlights_en: Agents build on Computer projects, skills, memory and connected tools.
The primary post specifies web first, iOS later, with existing permissions and review controls.
article.why: 行銷團隊可把持續監察與跟進工作寫成有交付物的任務，亦需要清楚指定何時須批准。
article.why_en: Marketing teams can define monitoring and follow-up as ongoing assignments with deliverables and approval boundaries.
article.next_step: 先選一項只讀競品監察，列出資料來源、交稿格式、停止條件及須人手決定的步驟。
article.next_step_en: Start with read-only competitor monitoring and define sources, output format, stop conditions and human decisions.
article.detail: 官方把廣告監察、客戶跟進及營運管理列為用途示例，這不是已驗證的客戶成效。Teammates可協調其他代理，使用者仍可查看進度、改變方向或接手操作。它沿用Computer既有的工具與項目權限，各代理的瀏覽器環境亦分開。近期報道對iOS開放時間的描述不一，本報採用原文的『稍後推出』，不把Free或Pro方案寫成已包含此功能。
article.detail_en: Marketing and sales examples are proposed uses, not verified customer outcomes. Users can inspect, redirect or take over work. Permissions follow Computer and browser environments are separate. This report follows the primary post’s iOS-later wording rather than conflicting secondary coverage.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
